verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly touches this story. Render Blueprints let you define and deploy an entire architecture from a single render.yaml file, the kind of mechanism templates could build on (render-docs-9, render-docs-29, render-docs-28). A use-case guide exists for running ClickHouse on Render (render-docs-35). Nothing shows a one-click deploy button or a curated gallery of templates or starters. Missing for 10: a documented one-click deploy flow, a template or starter catalog for common frameworks and use cases, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
